From 9bdda4e9cf2dcecb60a0683b10ffb8cd7e5f2f45 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Amir Goldstein <amir73il@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Sep 2018 09:40:01 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] fsnotify: fix ignore mask logic in fsnotify()

Commit 92183a42898d ("fsnotify: fix ignore mask logic in
send_to_group()") acknoledges the use case of ignoring an event on
an inode mark, because of an ignore mask on a mount mark of the same
group (i.e. I want to get all events on this file, except for the events
that came from that mount).

This change depends on correctly merging the inode marks and mount marks
group lists, so that the mount mark ignore mask would be tested in
send_to_group(). Alas, the merging of the lists did not take into
account the case where event in question is not in the mask of any of
the mount marks.

To fix this, completely remove the tests for inode and mount event masks
from the lists merging code.

Fixes: 92183a42898d ("fsnotify: fix ignore mask logic in send_to_group")
Signed-off-by: Amir Goldstein <amir73il@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jan Kara <jack@suse.cz>

diff --git a/fs/notify/fsnotify.c b/fs/notify/fsnotify.c
index f174397b63a0..ababdbfab537 100644
--- a/fs/notify/fsnotify.c
+++ b/fs/notify/fsnotify.c
@@ -351,16 +351,9 @@ int fsnotify(struct inode *to_tell, __u32 mask, const void *data, int data_is,
 
 	iter_info.srcu_idx = srcu_read_lock(&fsnotify_mark_srcu);
 
-	if ((mask & FS_MODIFY) ||
-	    (test_mask & to_tell->i_fsnotify_mask)) {
-		iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE] =
-			fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks);
-	}
-
-	if (mnt && ((mask & FS_MODIFY) ||
-		    (test_mask & mnt->mnt_fsnotify_mask))) {
-		iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE] =
-			fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks);
+	iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE] =
+		fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks);
+	if (mnt) {
 		iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_VFSMOUNT] =
 			fsnotify_first_mark(&mnt->mnt_fsnotify_marks);
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `fs/notify/fsnotify.c`**
- Removed conditional checks for the inode and mount event masks when merging the lists. Specifically, the checks that determined whether to set `iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE]` based on the `mask` and `test_mask` have been eliminated.
- The assignment of `iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE]` is now unconditional, directly calling `fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks)` regardless of the event mask conditions.
- The logic for setting `iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_VFSMOUNT]` remains unchanged, but it is now only dependent on the presence of a mount (`mnt`).

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `fsnotify.c` are aimed at fixing the logic related to the ignore mask handling in the `fsnotify()` function. By removing the conditional checks for the inode and mount event masks, the patch ensures that the merging of inode and mount marks is done correctly, allowing the ignore mask on a mount mark to be effectively applied without being incorrectly filtered out by the previous logic. This change is directly related to the fix for the bug acknowledged in the previous commit (92183a42898d), which aimed to improve the handling of event notifications based on ignore masks.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (!(mask & FS_MODIFY) &&
    !(test_mask & to_tell->i_fsnotify_mask) &&
    !(mnt && test_mask & mnt->mnt_fsnotify_mask))
    return 0;
```
```c
if ((mask & FS_MODIFY) ||
    (test_mask & to_tell->i_fsnotify_mask)) {
    iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE] =
        fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks);
}
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the logic incorrectly checks the ignore masks for both inode and mount marks during the merging process. Specifically, it fails to account for cases where the event is not in the mask of any mount marks, leading to events that should be ignored not being filtered out correctly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE] =
    fsnotify_first_mark(&to_tell->i_fsnotify_marks);
```
```c
if (mnt) {
    iter_info.marks[FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_VFSMOUNT] =
        fsnotify_first_mark(&mnt->mnt_fsnotify_marks);
}
```
Reason:
The fix removes the conditional checks for inode and mount event masks during the merging of the lists, ensuring that the inode marks are always set correctly. This allows the ignore mask logic to function properly, ensuring that events are filtered according to the correct ignore masks.
